articles.title: Adani Airport Holdings Signs ₹2,790 Crore (US$300 Million) Equity Deal At An $18 Billion Valuation
articles.snippet:
Adani Airport Holdings has signed a binding agreement to raise ₹2,790 crore (US$300 million) from funds and affiliates of 360 ONE Alternates Asset Management, bringing its announced equity raise to US$1.35 billion.
The post Adani Airport Holdings Signs ₹2,790 Crore (US$300 Million) Equity Deal At An $18 Billion Valuation appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
Adani Airport Holdings Signs ₹2,790 Crore (US$300 Million) Equity Deal At An $18 Billion Valuation
By Amit Chowdhry
Today at 12:46 PM
Adani Airport Holdings Signs ₹2,790 Crore (US$300 Million) Equity Deal At An $18 Billion Valuation
Adani Airport Holdings has signed a binding agreement to raise ₹2,790 crore (US$300 million) from funds and affiliates of 360 ONE Alternates Asset Management, bringing its announced equity raise to US$1.35 billion.
Under the share subscription agreement, 360 ONE Asset will acquire newly issued shares on the same terms as investors in the earlier round. The transaction implies a pre-money equity valuation of approximately US$18 billion.
Once both transactions are completed, participating investors will collectively own approximately 7.01% of Adani Airport Holdings, a subsidiary of Adani Enterprises.
Funding Airport Expansion
The earlier round raised ₹9,825 crore, approximately US$1 billion, in primary equity from a consortium including Alpha Wave Global, Premji Invest, Temasek and BlackRock-managed funds.
The capital will support airport network upgrades, including passenger services and non-aeronautical businesses. Adani Airport Holdings aims to increase annual passenger-handling capacity from nearly 96 million to 200 million, more than doubling its existing capacity.
KEY QUOTES
“This partnership is yet another milestone in building out the Adani Airports platform. Having such marquee, long-term investors on board is a testament to their confidence in India’s aviation growth story.”
Jeet Adani, Non-Executive Director Of Adani Airport Holdings

articles.title: Sea Box Receives $216.4 Million Army Vehicle For Expandable Maintenance Shelters
articles.snippet:
Sea Box has received a $216.36 million firm-fixed-price indefinite-delivery Army contract to supply one-sided expandable shelters for two maintenance shop programs.
The post Sea Box Receives $216.4 Million Army Vehicle For Expandable Maintenance Shelters appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
Sea Box Receives $216.4 Million Army Vehicle For Expandable Maintenance Shelters
By Amit Chowdhry
Today at 12:09 PM
Sea Box Receives $216.4 Million Army Vehicle For Expandable Maintenance Shelters
Sea Box has received a $216.36 million firm-fixed-price indefinite-delivery Army contract to supply one-sided expandable shelters for two maintenance shop programs.
The shelters will serve as the physical enclosures for the Armament Repair Shop Set and the Metal Working and Machining Shop Set. The award covers shelter supply rather than a separately described procurement of the equipment housed inside them.
The Army selected Sea Box following an online solicitation that attracted eight bids. The award notice designated the company as a small business.
Orders Will Establish Locations And Funding
Work locations and funding will be determined with each order placed under the contract.
The announced $216.36 million contract value should therefore be distinguished from funds obligated for individual orders. The provided notice does not identify an initial funding obligation or specify how many shelters the Army will purchase.
The indefinite-delivery arrangement allows requirements to be addressed through orders issued under the broader agreement. Those orders will establish the applicable performance locations and funding commitments.
Completion Expected In November 2031
Estimated completion is November 21, 2031, establishing the announced timeframe for contract performance.
Army Contracting Command at Detroit Arsenal, Michigan, is the contracting activity responsible for the procurement. The contract is identified as W912CH-27-D-A104.

articles.title: Arch MI Secures $202.5 Million In Reinsurance Through Bellemeade Transaction
articles.snippet:
Arch Mortgage Insurance Company has secured $202.5 million in indemnity reinsurance covering a pool representing approximately $55 billion in mortgages through Bellemeade Re 2026-1, a special-purpose reinsurer.
The post Arch MI Secures $202.5 Million In Reinsurance Through Bellemeade Transaction appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
Arch MI Secures $202.5 Million In Reinsurance Through Bellemeade Transaction
By Amit Chowdhry
Today at 1:06 PM
Arch MI Secures $202.5 Million In Reinsurance Through Bellemeade Transaction
Arch Mortgage Insurance Company has secured $202.5 million in indemnity reinsurance covering a pool representing approximately $55 billion in mortgages through Bellemeade Re 2026-1, a special-purpose reinsurer.
The transaction closed November 24 and combines approximately $162 million in insurance-linked notes with $40.5 million in direct reinsurance.
The coverage primarily relates to mortgage insurance policies issued by Arch MI and its affiliates from September 2025 through October 2026. The $55 billion figure represents the underlying mortgage pool, while $202.5 million is the reinsurance protection obtained.
Five Note Classes Support Risk Transfer
Bellemeade Re 2026-1 is funding its reinsurance obligations through five classes of amortizing notes, each with a 10-year legal final maturity.
The issuance includes approximately $45.94 million in Class M-1A notes paying one-month SOFR plus 1.50% and $45.94 million in Class M-1B notes paying SOFR plus 2%.
The remaining classes comprise approximately $36.27 million in Class M-1C notes at SOFR plus 2.50%, $19.34 million in Class M-2 notes at SOFR plus 3%, and $14.51 million in Class B-1 notes at SOFR plus 4.50%.
Morningstar DBRS assigned ratings ranging from BBB (low)(sf) for Class M-1A to B (sf) for Class B-1. An additional $40.503 million was placed with a panel of reinsurers.
Bellemeade Program Reaches 23 Transactions
The deal is Arch’s first mortgage insurance-linked note transaction of 2026. Since launching the Bellemeade program in 2015, the company has completed 23 transactions securing nearly $10 billion in indemnity reinsurance.
Arch MI described the program as an important component of its risk and capital management strategy, with the latest transaction’s amortization structure aligned with its PMIERs capital requirements.
Headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina, Arch MI is a wholly owned subsidiary of Arch Capital Group. Its flagship insurer is licensed to write mortgage insurance in all 50 states, the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico.
KEY QUOTES
“We have issued at least one Bellemeade transaction a year since 2015, and we remain committed to the program as an important part of Arch’s risk and capital management strategy.”
“We are very pleased with the execution of this transaction. Strong investor engagement allowed us to achieve attractive execution across the capital structure, while maintaining an amortization structure aligned with our PMIERs capital requirements.”
Jennifer Weiss, Vice President Of Structured Capital And Reinsurance At Arch MI

articles.title: E.F. Hutton Advises Poco Loco Holdings Group on $188.2 Million Financing
articles.snippet:
E.F. Hutton & Co., a New York-based investment bank and broker-dealer, served as exclusive financial advisor to Poco Loco Holdings... Read More
The post E.F. Hutton Advises Poco Loco Holdings Group on $188.2 Million Financing appeared first on citybiz .
articles.text:
Global , New York
General Business , Venture Capital
E.F. Hutton Advises Poco Loco Holdings Group on $188.2 Million Financing
November 25, 2026
E.F. Hutton & Co. , a New York-based investment bank and broker-dealer, served as exclusive financial advisor to Poco Loco Holdings Group LLC on an approximately $188.2 million financing transaction comprising mortgage financing, land sale-leaseback and build-to-suit financing arrangements.
The transaction will enable Poco Loco to unlock capital from its existing real estate portfolio, enhance liquidity and support future development, expansion initiatives and construction of multiple retail locations.
Poco Loco is a family-owned, Texas-based Hispanic grocery and convenience retail operator serving communities across Central and South Texas.
The company has grown from a single neighborhood grocery store into a diversified retail platform encompassing full-service supermarkets, meat markets, convenience stores and gas stations.
Supported by more than 1,000 employees, Poco Loco specializes in providing fresh, authentic and affordable groceries to the communities it serves.
The financing combines multiple real estate-backed funding structures, allowing Poco Loco to optimize its property holdings while securing capital to support its long-term expansion strategy.
“Convenience and fuel operators often hold valuable real estate, and financing it well takes a structure that reflects both the property and the business that operates on it,” said Duncan B. Swanston , president of E.F. Hutton.
“We are pleased to have advised Poco Loco on this financing and look forward to supporting the company as it continues to grow.”
The transaction highlights E.F. Hutton’s private credit capabilities, which include structuring and arranging customized financing solutions across direct lending, mezzanine financing, real estate-backed financing and structured credit.
The individual financing amounts, participating lenders and other transaction terms were not disclosed.
Headquartered in New York City, E.F. Hutton provides investment banking, financial advisory, capital raising and financing services to corporations, financial sponsors and institutional investors across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Asia and Latin America.
The $188.2 million financing positions Poco Loco to expand its retail footprint while leveraging the value of its existing real estate assets to support continued growth across Texas.

articles.title: Sabre Systems Receives $155.7 Million Increase To Navy Engineering Support Ceiling
articles.snippet:
Sabre Systems received a $155.69 million increase to the labor-cost ceiling on an existing Naval Air Systems Command engineering support contract.
The post Sabre Systems Receives $155.7 Million Increase To Navy Engineering Support Ceiling appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
Sabre Systems Receives $155.7 Million Increase To Navy Engineering Support Ceiling
By Amit Chowdhry
Today at 12:16 PM
Sabre Systems Receives $155.7 Million Increase To Navy Engineering Support Ceiling
Sabre Systems received a $155.69 million increase to the labor-cost ceiling on an existing Naval Air Systems Command engineering support contract.
The modification raises the ceiling from $499.92 million to $655.61 million while leaving the fee unchanged. The increase expands the contract’s available labor-cost capacity rather than representing an immediate funding obligation.
The indefinite-delivery, indefinite-quantity contract supports Naval Air Systems Command program offices with systems engineering, research and development, technical baseline work and engineering assessments.
Individual Orders Will Receive Funding
The Navy obligated no funds when it issued the modification. Funding will instead be committed through individual orders as they are issued under the contract.
The revised ceiling therefore establishes capacity for work ordered through the agreement, with actual funding obligations determined separately. It does not mean the full $655.61 million has been obligated.
Maryland Accounts For Most Work
Sabre Systems will perform 40% of the work in Lexington Park, Maryland, and 30% in Patuxent River, Maryland.
The remaining 30% will take place at other locations within the continental United States. Completion is expected in April 2030.
The initial contract was competitively procured. Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division at Patuxent River issued modification P00010 under the existing engineering support agreement.

articles.snippet:
Walker & Dunlop arranged a $122.1 million refinancing for 530 Fifth Avenue, a fully leased retail condominium in Midtown Manhattan. Rialto Capital Management provided the floating-rate, interest-only loan.
The post Walker & Dunlop Secures $122.1 Million Loan On Fully Leased Fifth Avenue Retail Property appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
Walker & Dunlop Secures $122.1 Million Loan On Fully Leased Fifth Avenue Retail Property
By Amit Chowdhry
Yesterday at 11:21 PM
Walker & Dunlop Secures $122.1 Million Loan On Fully Leased Fifth Avenue Retail Property
Walker & Dunlop arranged a $122.1 million refinancing for 530 Fifth Avenue, a fully leased retail condominium in Midtown Manhattan. Rialto Capital Management provided the floating-rate, interest-only loan.
Walker & Dunlop’s Capital Markets Institutional Advisory team served as exclusive adviser to Aurora Capital Associates and AVRS Partners. Aaron Appel, Dustin Stolly, Jonathan Schwartz, Keith Kurland, Adam Schwartz, Sean Reimer, Jordan Casella and Stanley Cayre arranged the financing.
Five Tenants Occupy The Three-Level Property
The 58,989-square-foot condominium spans the west side of Fifth Avenue between 44th and 45th streets, with approximately 200 feet of storefront frontage. Its five tenants are Chase Bank, Walgreens, Five Below, Vans and UGG.
The property sits between Upper Fifth Avenue’s luxury retail corridor and shopping destinations farther south. Nearby offices, hotels and transit connections bring foot traffic to the area, as do Grand Central Terminal, Bryant Park, Times Square and Rockefeller Center.
Walker & Dunlop said its Capital Markets team sourced more than $13.9 billion from non-agency capital providers in the first half of 2026, including nearly $9.6 billion for multifamily properties.
KEY QUOTES:
“530 Fifth Avenue’s combination of prime frontage, established tenancy, and location within one of the world’s most recognized shopping destinations make it a highly attractive asset. With the property fully leased and benefiting from strong in-place cash flow, this refinancing positions our client to capitalize on the long-term value of the asset. We appreciate the opportunity to work with Aurora Capital, AVRS Partners, and Rialto Capital Management on this transaction.”
Aaron Appel, Senior Managing Director Of Capital Markets And Co-Head Of Institutional Advisory At Walker & Dunlop

articles.title: Ritzey Therapeutics Debuts With $112.5 Million And A Drug Candidate Headed For Phase 2
articles.snippet:
Ritzey Therapeutics has launched with a $112.5 million Series A to develop treatments for chronic metabolic and neurological conditions. The clinical-stage biotechnology company also completed its acquisition of Perha Pharmaceuticals, adding a portfolio of experimental medicines, including a lead candidate that has completed Phase 1 testing.
The post Ritzey Therapeutics Debuts With $112.5 Million And A Drug Candidate Headed For Phase 2 appeared first on Pulse 2.0 .
articles.text:
Ritzey Therapeutics Debuts With $112.5 Million And A Drug Candidate Headed For Phase 2
By Amit Chowdhry
Today at 12:10 PM
Ritzey Therapeutics Debuts With $112.5 Million And A Drug Candidate Headed For Phase 2
Ritzey Therapeutics has launched with a $112.5 million Series A to develop treatments for chronic metabolic and neurological conditions. The clinical-stage biotechnology company also completed its acquisition of Perha Pharmaceuticals, adding a portfolio of experimental medicines, including a lead candidate that has completed Phase 1 testing.
Vida Ventures led the financing, with participation from EcoR1 Capital, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Perceptive Advisors, Montanova, Alexandria Venture Investments and FMB Research. Vida Ventures Managing Director Matt Cohen joined Ritzey’s board. Leerink Partners served as sole placement agent.
Perha Acquisition Brings A Clinical Pipeline
Ritzey plans to advance its once-daily oral drug candidate into Phase 2 studies. The candidate targets DYRK1A, an enzyme involved in insulin-producing pancreatic beta-cell function and neuronal signaling. The proposed studies will examine beta-cell function and changes in the tau protein in people with Down syndrome, along with beta-cell function in people with type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
The scientific team that led development of the programs at Perha will join Ritzey. Founder Sharon Mates serves as chair, CEO and president. She previously founded and led Intra-Cellular Therapies through its 2025 acquisition by Johnson & Johnson. Several former members of that company’s senior management team have also joined Ritzey.
KEY QUOTE
“Our team has a rich history of investigating and understanding intracellular signaling pathways to develop and deliver innovative medicines for the treatment of chronic diseases. Bringing that same expertise to Ritzey, we will continue to work towards improving the treatment of chronic diseases for patients. We are studying the effects of the disturbances of these pathways in individuals with Down syndrome, examining metabolic effects, cognitive disturbances and tau hyperphosphorylation (an early predictor of Alzheimer’s disease). Additionally, DYRK1A inhibitors target a root cause of insulin insufficiency in diabetes in the general population, and we will examine our inhibitors in both T1D and T2D. At Ritzey, we have the opportunity to advance a novel mechanism of action that could effectively alter the course of these chronic diseases. I am proud to be joined by members of the former senior management team at Intra-Cellular Therapies, and we are grateful to Vida Ventures and our other investors for their support as we move forward with our Phase 2 clinical trials.”
Dr. Sharon Mates, Founder, Chair, CEO And President Of Ritzey Therapeutics
